executiveSummary: Several major tech trends emerged from the articles, including the rise of AI and ML, hardware releases, and pricing changes. Apple's MacBook Pro and iPhone Black Friday deals showcased significant price drops, while the company faces a trial over planned obsolescence. Meanwhile, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella discussed the role of AI in workforce reductions, and Canva introduced new controls for its generative AI features.
